Frequency once per day

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 ally

Outside-flavored, open to all — once per day, grant an ally the same geometry-defying exception to facing and straight-line movement for one action.

For the ally's next action, taken before the end of its next turn, it ignores facing, flanking, and straight-line movement restrictions entirely — how it got there does not have to make geometric sense. Nobody watching, including the ally, can afterwards explain the route it took.
